{{Quote|Take them to Camp Four.|[[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace" />}}
'''Camp Four''' was a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]-of-war camp established on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Mainly used to hold political prisoners, it also held a number of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. The camp was later [[Liberation of Camp Four|liberated]] by members of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] Camp Four was situated in a valley on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and a river ran in front. The camp was guarded by a laser fence, which was deactivated when a convoy of prisoners arrived from the nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. The prisoner barracks were divided into four separate locations, sequestered in the hills. The barracks were surrounded by further laser fences and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and powered by nearby generators. A Federation airbase was established nearby to act as a decoy for the camp.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
When the Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the planet in 32 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> their forces quickly secured the planetary leadership in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] and her entourage were to be processed at Camp Four until the arrival of two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Their intervention gave the Queen the chance to escape.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace" /> [[Baras Perosei]] was captured and imprisoned in the camp.<ref name="Perosei">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Officer Perosei}}</ref>

The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] became guerrilla fighters against the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]],<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> and a group led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] [[Liberation of Camp Four|attacked]] the camp looking for allies. Sykes led a quartet of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] into the valley under cover of darkness. One of the pilots, [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]] had family in the camp and broke formation, alerting the Federation forces to his presence. [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid starfighters]] launched from the airbase to engage the pilots, but the Naboo fighters shot them down. Sykes landed in the hangar and stole a speeder, and infiltrated the camp using empty [[Platoon Attack Craft/Legends|transports]] as a decoy.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Sykes broke through the laser fence and systematically freed the prisoners, who took nearby [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] to escape. A group of [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] ambushed Sykes, but were destroyed in a strafing run by his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]]. Sykes then freed the remaining prisoners and led them out of the camp.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camp Four received a passing mention in the first [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|movie]] of the [[Prequel trilogy]] in [[1999]]. Its location was expanded upon in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
